title: Storing Authentication Token in Unencrypted Local File
description: The application writes raw authentication tokens directly into a plaintext file (`auth_token.txt`) on local/external storage via `File('.../auth_token.txt').writeAsString(token)`.
attack_vector: Any process with shared storage access, ADB backup capability, or media-store read access can read `auth_token.txt` and compromise the authenticated session.
fix_rationale: Eliminate raw file persistence for credentials and store session tokens exclusively inside `FlutterSecureStorage`.
